theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ir_ideal_inertia_to_valuation
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] (q : ℕ), q.Prime → ∀ P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → ∃ V : ValuationSubring E, V.LiesOverPrime q ∧ P.inertia (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) ≤ V.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ
